name: @lacs/mobile
description: Capacitor shell that packages the LACS dashboard as a sideloadable Android APK.

scripts.sync: npm run build --workspace @lacs/web && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
